name: Embroidered Coaster
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

-Made from high-quality fabric with durable stitching, this embroidered coaster provides a soft yet sturdy surface for daily use.

-The  material helps protect tables and surfaces from heat, moisture, and scratches while maintaining a stylish appearance.

-The carefully crafted embroidery adds texture and a refined handmade feel to each piece.

 

  •  Sizes & Dimensions:

-Standard size: 15.24 cm × 15.24 cm (6 × 6 inches)

-Embroidery area: 10 × 10 cm (3.94 × 3.94 inches)

-Recommended embroidery area for large design: 6 x 6 cm (~2.3 x 2.3 inches)
 

  • Embroidery Technology

- Produced using premium embroidery technology with detailed stitching and vibrant thread colors.
- Durable embroidery maintains its appearance through regular use.

 

  • Design File/Embroidery Notes:

📌Please carefully read the guidelines for preparing file .png and the design requirements/limitations before submitting your artwork to ensure the best quality outcome.

- Thread colors: Compatible with embroidery files that contain up to 5 different thread colors.
- Avoid designs with:
          + Very thin lines under 2mm,
          + Photographic or gradient-based images,
          + Overly complex or dimensional graphics.
- Recommended styles:
          + Simple text (bold, sans-serif fonts),
          + Monoline designs, avoid large area of solid design
          + Flat/simple shapes without excessive detail.
 

  • Care Instructions:
    - For Iron-On Coaster, wait at least 24 hours after application before washing.
    - Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle.
    - Do not use bleach or harsh detergents.
    - Air dry whenever possible for maximum longevity.
    - For heavy-use garments, additional stitching is recommended to enhance durability.

 

  • Functional & Usage:

Perfect for protecting surfaces and adding a decorative touch to any space, including:

-Coffee tables, dining tables, and office desks

-Cups, mugs, glasses, and everyday drinkware

-Home décor, restaurants, cafés, and workplaces

-Special events and personalized decorations

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

- A thoughtful personalized gift for birthdays, housewarmings, holidays, weddings, and special celebrations.

- Great for coffee lovers, home décor enthusiasts, and anyone who enjoys unique customized items.

- A practical yet stylish gift that combines creativity and everyday functionality.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x  Embroidered Coaster

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.3-0.5 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
